description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableMeasurement class, a likely immutable data object related to measurements in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It verifies correctness of equals/hashCode, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and uses constants from TestConstants.

classes.name: ImmutableMeasurementTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ImmutableMeasurement class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, using constants and methods from the connectivity package.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableMeasurement correctly implements hashCode and equals methods, using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableMeasurement is immutable and that its MetricType dependencies are also immutable.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method of ImmutableMeasurement produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the static fromJson method correctly reconstructs an ImmutableMeasurement from JSON.
